title: Cancel unknown viscosity exactly in a forward/inverse target leaf
statement: For constant nu, A_F^nu(a)=Q_F(a)v+nu a Delta F obeys the group law and inverse A_F^nu(-a),since Q_F fixes Delta F. Any forward affine word A^nu z=S z+nu d satisfies A^nu T_g (A^nu)^-1 z=z+Sg exactly. For S=Q_G(b)Q_F(a), chronological G(-b),F(-a),seed g,F(a),G(b) realizes the same endpoint at EVERY constant nu. Use q(z)=6z(1-z),carrier w=(a/ell)qF, emitted f=w_t; seed f=(1/ell)q g. Round phase/seed before leaf and reuse identical rounded inverse shear. Both homogeneous Euler/magnetic propagators return I. Analysis reference ustar=w+v_nu,Bstar0 has v_t+L_wv=nu Delta w+fseed; its smooth norm<=K_m(A)^2(||z||Hm+||g||Hm+CA),A=1+|a|+|b|,independent compression. Sole reference residual nu Delta v-B(v,v); all large carrier terms cancel. Supplied transformed coupled energy gives E_prime+P^-1(H2error^2)<=P(E+E^3+1+eta^2),hence norm_out<=(1+Ph)norm_in+P sqrt(h)(1+eta) for short rational h. Completed endpoint coordinates are physical. No diffusion-near-I operator norm on H1 ball. Zero-force quadratic holds with h alpha^2=dose have transport h alpha=sqrt(dose h), viscosity contribution polynomial times sqrt(h), retaining two-stage synthesis without h alpha^4. Time constancy of actual nu is essential to affine cancellation.
